about: Situations for the thinking pass (waggle/think.py). Every person and detail here is made up. None of these situations has any code or prompt line of its own: the pass must get them from the picture and its knowledge of the world. 'tune' cases may be looked at while wording the prompt; 'holdout' cases are only ever scored. A new example from the owner is added here, never to the code.

base.What they have said they want from you (:

- I care more about things I would have missed than about things I already know.
- No generic productivity nagging and nothing salesy.
